Conquest changes jurisdiction; a court prescribes a documentary language; a school makes competence in that language ordinary; a later generation receives the achieved arrangement as its native world. The [owning history](HISTORY.md) preserves the twelve branches through which this movement becomes concrete. This companion develops their chronology and consequence while keeping the protected body intact. The branch numbers retain that body's identities; the six positions organise their relations without converting twelve histories into six universal stages. The [E3 field](../../../etymologies/trust-place-logos-nomos-natio-credere/WHOLE-FIELD.md#relational-offices) supplies the complete movement **Fides→Topos→Logos→Nomos→Natio→Credere→Fides**. Reliance becomes situated, articulated and administered; an arrangement is inherited as belonging; examination makes renewed entrustment possible. Its inner **Topos→Logos→Nomos→Natio** names the recurrent attempt to align place, language, law and people. These are authorial relational offices. The [Greek](../../../sources/classical-philology/liddell-scott-jones/lsj-1940-greek-english-lexicon/SOURCE.md) and [Latin](../../../sources/classical-philology/lewis-short/lewis-short-1879-latin-dictionary/SOURCE.md) houses now supply selected lexical witnesses; their separate word histories do not establish one chronology of civilisation. Centralisation makes arbitration consequential at a wider scale. More persons must have their acts recognised through a common jurisdiction, and that jurisdiction needs sufficiently shared forms of naming and recording. Yet a common form does not make every speaker equally able to use it. The person who translates, the official who admits a document, the institution that teaches the accepted language and the authority that can revise its rules occupy different positions in the same process. Their differences are where the history becomes more exact than a general story of increasing unity. [E2's generated relations](../../../etymologies/arbitration-hybris-regard-anamnesis/WHOLE-FIELD.md#arbitration-in-crisis) distinguish the consequential decision from its possible usurpation of authority. Arbitration-in-Crisis is the deciding relation; hybris is its closure when a local determination assumes the office of its determining condition. Con-text-through-Diaphaneity makes the affected field available to Regard. Resolution-in-Reconciliation returns a settlement through its history. The [E6 field](../../../etymologies/apportionment-and-economy/WHOLE-FIELD.md#canonical-operations) adds what is distributed: finite capacity, criteria, delegated labour, local governing powers and the wider economy sustaining an act. A national language can therefore be examined through both the authority it acquires and the capacities, costs and exclusions apportioned through it. The historical and archetypal accounts meet without sharing evidential authority. A marriage transmits a particular claim; a motherland image can give belonging an affective body; a law creates an administrative distinction. The document, image and enacted consequence require different witnesses. Their common field does not make one people's history a stage in another people's development, nor does a shared psychic morphology establish a route of textual transmission. The chronological branches below preserve that distinction at the point of use. ## #1 — A region enters a kingdom while its texts travel elsewhere ### I — Occitania: incorporation, legal French and national schooling The Occitan south enters this account before the later French nation-state has made territory, speech and people appear coincident. The inherited chronology begins with the Albigensian Crusade in **1209**, continues through the **1229** Treaty of Paris and reaches the incorporation of Toulouse into the royal domain in **1271**. These dates mark different political acts. A crusade, a settlement and the transfer of a territorial lordship do not themselves describe what language a household spoke or how a local court recorded every dispute. The sequence establishes the branch's temporal problem: political incorporation precedes the much later dominance of a common administrative and educational language. Its treaty clauses and local linguistic effects remain separate primary-document tasks. The **1539** ordinance gives one later intervention an exact textual body. In articles **110–111**, François I requires clarity in judgments and prescribes French for specified judicial acts, procedures, registers and instruments, addressing difficulties associated with Latin wording. The [canonical passage](../../../sources/political-theory-institutions/francois-i/francois-i-1539-villers-cotterets/SOURCE.md#francois-i-1539-villers-cotterets-q001) establishes that prescription. It does not show that everyone immediately spoke French or that all regional languages were abolished by those articles. The operative change concerns the language in which an act can travel through the jurisdiction and reach its parties with recognised force. In **1794**, the scale and justification change. Grégoire's intervention before the Convention joins accurate public acts and access to office to a programme of national linguistic uniformity. His proposed answer to exclusion through insufficient French is also an answer that would eliminate regional idioms. The [housed excerpt](../../../sources/political-theory-institutions/gregoire/gregoire-1794-unite-de-langue/SOURCE.md#gregoire-1794-unite-de-langue-q001) preserves both sides, including his response to southern attachment and literary traditions. Its omissions remain visible: this is neither the complete report nor the annexed decree, and its reported language counts are the speaker's claims. Nineteenth- and twentieth-century schooling form the next institutional phase in the protected history. The chronology now moves from prescribing a record's form to forming the future speaker. This is how an acquired national standard can become a child's inherited language. The word *patois* belongs inside the process: characterising a speech-world as deficient can justify policy whose effects then seem to confirm the characterisation. That feedback is the author's developed diagnosis; tracing its actual force still requires school instructions, teaching practice and testimony from affected speakers. The branch returns to E3 with access and assimilation held together, and to E2 with the question of whose evidence could change the deciding language policy. ### II — Posquières and Lunel: learning exceeds territorial incorporation The same region contains a learned history which cannot be read as a derivative of its incorporation into France. The inherited branch places **Abraham ben David of Posquières, RABaD III**, and **Isaac the Blind** in the southern French scholarly and early Kabbalistic field. **Lunel**, **Maimonides** and the **ibn Tibbon** translations carry another set of relations within that regional world. Their proximity matters, but it does not make philosophical translation and Kabbalistic teaching one transmission chain. A particular letter now supplies a recoverable contact. The Princeton Geniza Project identifies **Bodleian MS heb. b 11/33** as a letter from **Yonatan ha-Kohen of Lunel to Maimonides**, dated by inference within **1168–1204**. Its description and displayed Stern translation name **Samuel ibn Tibbon**, his father's instruction in Arabic, the community's reception of translated works and its request for the remaining *Guide*. The transcription is excerpted, and the later date on the manuscript is not the date of composition. This is a bounded witness to requesting, translating and circulating learning across **Provence and Egypt**. It establishes no itinerary from Isaac the Blind to Pico. [Letter, description and translation](https://geniza.princeton.edu/en/documents/19297/). The act of translation changes access without making the translated work originate in the receiving language. A community can address a distant authority, depend upon a particular translator and incorporate the resulting text into its own learned life. Political geography and intellectual geography therefore remain partially non-coincident. Their intersection becomes historically consequential wherever migration, exclusion or institutional disruption changes who can teach, read or transmit. The routes toward **Catalonia/Spain, Provence and Italy**, and onward into **Christian Kabbalah**, retain their inherited transmission-research standing. Manuscript descent, family movement, teaching and patronage must connect each edge. Occultation likewise has several possible historical bodies: destruction of a school, displacement of a community, loss of a language, restricted teaching, or later refusal to recognise a practice as knowledge. The recovered letter makes one positive relation available while those other mechanisms remain distinguishable. E3 receives a Logos carried across jurisdictions; E6 receives the translator's entrusted labour and the community whose access depends upon it. ## #2 — Transmission changes what can count as knowledge ### III — Florence, Venice and Milan: patronage, dynastic claim and mathesis The Renaissance branch follows several kinds of movement together. In **Florence**, the protected programme assigns **Cosimo de' Medici's patronage**, **Ficino's Hermetic translation before his return to Plato**, and the learned world of **Pico** their concrete office: acquisition and commission determine which texts can be read and in which language. Patronage here distributes time, access and authority. The resulting philosophical availability is an effect of those decisions, while the exact commission and downstream textual network still require their own edition-specific documents. The **Visconti–Orléans** relation moves another kind of claim. **Valentina Visconti's marriage to Louis I of Orléans** carries a Milanese dynastic claim into the French royal lineage; **Louis XII** later makes that inherited claim politically consequential in the Italian Wars. Marriage is part of the infrastructure of succession. Its office differs from translating a manuscript, even when people, household objects, heraldry and learned practices travel through overlapping courts. The programme retains this dynastic conduit as documented ground; it does not authorise every visual resemblance encountered along a possible route. That distinction governs the **Minervois Biscione**. The local serpent-child observation remains an unidentified object with a proposed heraldic relation. Without its exact site, date, patronage and renovation history, it cannot complete a Visconti transmission path. Its prospective visual/mythemic standing survives. No invented building or recovered photograph has been added to make the connection appear complete. **Pacioli and Leonardo** give the branch its mathematical hinge. The **1494 Summa**, with its printed accounting exposition, belongs to a practice of double entry that precedes its publication. The proportion and geometrical work associated with **Milan** has another public event in the **1509 Venetian edition of Divina proportione**. The Metropolitan Museum's copy, object **19.50**, is catalogued as a book with woodcuts after Leonardo, published by **Paganinus de Paganinus in Venice on 1 June 1509**. The object record verifies that printed carrier, not a complete reading of its argument. [Museum object record](https://www.metmuseum.org/art/collection/search/336656). The author's **undivided hinge of mathesis** names the proximity of calculative account and qualitative/proportional geometry within this field. Florence's philosophical patronage, Venice's commercial and printing activity, and Milan's mathematical collaboration remain geographically differentiated. Their later institutional futures need not be the same. **Differential occultation of qualitative mathesis** remains a research hypothesis about that divergence; neither the book's existence nor its divine title proves a later programme of suppression. E6 receives the different uses of account and measure; E3 receives the institutions through which a mathematical practice becomes communicable and authoritative. ### IV — Yates and Hanegraaff: the historian reopens an exclusion This branch looks back from modern historiography upon the Renaissance field. **Frances Yates** brought Hermetic and occult materials into the account of early modern science. The inherited programme retains her intervention and the qualification of its strongest causal form: re-admitting excluded material does not establish that one esoteric tradition generated modern science. The historical object includes lives and institutions in which theology, alchemy, astrology, magic and natural philosophy had not yet acquired their later disciplinary separations. Yates's selected passages and the precise later criticisms remain to be collated; their disagreement is preserved rather than resolved by a general declaration that everything was connected. **Wouter Hanegraaff** gives the historiographic turn a different emphasis. In his own account of **rejected knowledge**, traditions become marginal partly through the criteria by which modern academic culture recognises serious inquiry. Reputational dismissal can remove a speaker's capacity to be heard without physically destroying the surviving text. His account makes the historian's own inherited categories part of the inquiry. This is a consulted authorial statement of his research programme, not a claim to have read the whole 2012 monograph. [Hanegraaff, “Rejected Knowledge”](https://www.wouterjhanegraaff.net/rejected-knowledge). The chronological distinction is between a practice's earlier life, its later classification and a subsequent scholarly recovery. A text can survive materially while ceasing to count intellectually. Conversely, a lost text need not have been deliberately suppressed. Censorship, strategic secrecy, patronage, accidental loss, professionalisation and disciplinary exclusion remain different mechanisms. E2's Regard becomes concrete when a previously excluded object can alter a historiographical criterion; E3's Epi-Logos receives the achieved history turning back upon its own selections. The return does not make rejected claims true merely because they were rejected. ### V — Jung's Aion: the historical image and its limits **Aion** supplies the protected programme's psychological reading of historical time: **Christ/Antichrist, Pisces, Gnostic and alchemical images of the Self**, and a movement of opposition and reversal within the Christian aeon. The inherited branch also retains Jung's conjunction of **sixteenth-century schism**, an outward or horizontal movement of consciousness, discovery and the conquest of nature, and alchemy's relation to scientific modernity. These remain Jungian historical-psychological constructions as received in the programme. They are not supplied as independent causal history of the Reformation or scientific institutions. The [canonical Aion house](../../../sources/psychology/jung/jung-1978-aion-cw9-2/SOURCE.md#passages) retains the selected **1978 corrected hardcover printing** and now records sixteen contextual paraphrase locations from the actual **1979 paperback reading carrier**. AION-P06 identifies VII, §§150–154, pp. 95–97 for the sixteenth-century schism and outward turn; AION-P12 identifies XII, §§267–271, pp. 173–174 for alchemy, science and the later faith/knowledge division. These consulted locations make this branch recoverable. Collation against the selected printing and verification of any proposed quotation remain Open; neither is claimed by this passage map. Jung’s historical-psychological interpretation remains distinct from independent causal history. The psychic operation remains developed: an image can organise what a historical community fears, expects or recognises in an event. A polarity can give a sequence affective direction; a later account can receive an earlier figure under changed conditions. That reading needs the determinate history through which the image acted. It cannot establish a marriage, a treaty, a translation or an institutional decision by symbolic resemblance. Historical Logos and archetypal Logos thus return to one another through different questions. Shared Neumann structuration does not turn European religious time into the developmental measure of the other branches. E2 receives recollection that resituates an account; the mythic whole retains the complete symbolic telling and its separate source debt. ## #3 — A language becomes a condition of belonging and action ### VI — Italy: literary prestige becomes a public language project The Italian branch begins with a literary prestige that precedes unified state administration. Tuscan and Florentine writing provide an inherited resource; **unification in 1861** creates a different practical demand for communication across the national field. **Manzoni's 1868 report** belongs at this transition. The commission joins a writer's linguistic position to public educational policy without making literary recognition equivalent to widespread ordinary speech. The report argues for a **living Florentine** language and a dictionary representing its use. Manzoni answers four objections: that a national dictionary cannot rest upon one city, that Florentine is merely a dialect, that its adoption would impose a law, and that the dictionary must also explain writers of every period. He distinguishes providing a communicative means from a penal code, and a living-language dictionary from a historical one. He then gives regional comparative dictionaries a mediating role: speakers approach the proposed common language through words they already know. The consulted transcription is marked complete but not fully proofread; its argument is paraphrased, not quoted as a collated edition. [Manzoni, complete report](https://it.wikisource.org/wiki/Dell%27unit%C3%A0_della_lingua_e_dei_mezzi_di_diffonderla). The institutional movement is therefore more specific than replacing regional speech by decree. A selected living usage becomes a reference; lexicographic work makes it teachable; government support and education give it possible reach. The subsequent history of schooling, literacy and ordinary spoken Italian requires evidence beyond the proposal. Manzoni's own distinction between a useful means and compulsion must remain available when later policy is judged. E3 receives literary Logos becoming an administered resource; E6 receives the teachers, dictionaries and capacities through which that resource can become usable. ### VII — Germany: linguistic commonality and the later racialising cut The German branch preserves three different intellectual offices before following racialised administration. **Herder's** language-cultural relation retains its pluralistic and anti-imperial dimensions. **Fichte's Addresses of 1807–08** intervene under Napoleonic domination. **Jacob Grimm's** philology, grammar, mythology and legal-historical work contribute to a field whose cultural relations exceed fragmented state jurisdictions. Their coexistence does not make them authors of one doctrine or turn later racial law into an inevitable consequence of studying language. The consulted excerpts from Fichte's seventh and eighth addresses claim German originality and connect national continuation to education. They also distinguish state from nation and describe a person as belonging both to a particular state and to a wider German cultural fatherland. These are claims within Fichte's political-philosophical address, including its exclusionary claim to originality; his own etymological assertion about *deutsch* is not independently adopted here. [GHI edition, addresses VII–VIII, excerpted](https://germanhistorydocs.org/en/the-holy-roman-empire-1648-1815/ghdi:document-3596). The later transition becomes legally inspectable in **1935**. The **Reich Citizenship Law of 15 September** reserves full political rights to a racially defined class of subjects; its **First Regulation of 14 November** specifies classifications through grandparents and religious-community membership, with additional conditions for people assigned two Jewish grandparents. It excludes those classified as Jews from Reich citizenship, voting and public office. The distinction between state subjecthood and Reich citizenship is retained; the text is not described as immediate cancellation of every form of nationality. [GHI translation of both instruments, §§1–3 and §§2–5 respectively](https://germanhistorydocs.org/en/nazi-germany-1933-1945/the-reich-citizenship-law-september-15-1935-and-the-first-regulation-to-the-reich-citizenship-law-november-14-1935.pdf). The rule turns a record about ancestors into a present distribution of rights. That is the branch's exact **arbitration hardening into ontology**: an administratively instituted racial category acts as if it disclosed the person's natural being. The longer chain **linguistic relation→people→ancestry→biological race→juridical category→entitlement/exclusion** remains a transition-by-transition historical task. The two consulted endpoints do not establish every intervening conduit, nor a simple Fichte-to-Nazism genealogy. A24 receives the consequential category and its deciding office; E3 receives a belonging made administratively exclusive; E6 receives the concrete offices and capacities taken away. ### VIII — Wales, Ireland and Scotland: jurisdictional capability has three histories **Wales** enters through legal incorporation before the nineteenth-century educational inquiry. The inherited branch assigns the Laws in Wales Acts the extension of English law and legal language. The **1847 Blue Books** then make schooling, language, religion and social standing objects of official evaluation. These are separate institutional moments. The statute's exact clauses and their enforcement remain a primary collation task here; the education report cannot stand in for that law. One local observation complicates the general characterisation. A later Conwy history reproduces a passage identified as **Part III, pp.25–26**, recording an examination on **12 March 1847**. The examiner credits the master with English and Welsh competence and a successful method of interpretation while criticising organisation, training and material provision. This is a secondary reproduction of a named primary report, not an independently collated original. It nevertheless preserves a precise return task: linguistic practice, teaching organisation and resources must be distinguished before the evaluation is generalised into a judgement upon Welsh. [Conwy history, PDF pp.20–21](https://www.peoplescollection.wales/media/6108/download?attachment=). **Ireland** has a different institutional sequence in the protected branch: plantation and confiscation reorganise landholding; Anglicisation and the Protestant Ascendancy connect office, property and jurisdiction to a changed social order. A language's practical value increases where the institutions through which a person petitions, contracts, holds land or advances use it. The histories of those acts cannot be replaced by the Welsh school report. This companion preserves the property, religious and administrative mechanisms without inventing a plantation grant, family testimony or school order to close their local evidential gaps. **Scotland** likewise retains its own Gaelic, educational and administrative history. Centralising institutions can change the language in which advancement is possible while migration, commerce and bilingual adaptation change speakers' choices through other pressures. The Scottish chronology cannot be supplied by Ireland's land history or Wales's incorporation. Its legislation, school records and local testimony remain separately required before more precise causal attribution. Across the three branches, **English as jurisdictional capability** is a real operation rather than a verdict on every instance of learning English. Acquisition can enlarge a person's reach while the conditions rewarding it marginalise another speech-world. E6 receives capability and its distribution; E2 receives the criterion that judges it; E3 receives the historical process through which a language's social authority can later appear to be its inherent superiority. ## #4 — Sacred and national languages distribute people and place differently ### IX — Hebrew revival, Zionism and Palestinian counter-history Hebrew enters the modern revival with sacred, textual, literary and scholarly continuities already present. The new movement is its formation as an ordinary vernacular within a multilingual **Yishuv**, through households, schools, literature, journalism, theatre, song and lexicography. The historical question concerns how those activities acquire a mutually sustaining public reach. Neither ancient textual continuity nor one successful school alone establishes the resulting national configuration. The **1913 Language War** makes one disputed office visible. A protest against German instruction at the planned Technikum and Reali institutions treats the teaching language as constitutive of national revival. The National Library of Israel's presentation of the notice identifies **Yosef Lurie and Eliezer Ben-Yehuda** among its signatories. This is a particular nationalist intervention in technical education; the catalogue's description is not an independent collation of every signatory or the trustees' minutes. [Notice and institutional description](https://www.nli.org.il/en/education/teaching-resources/primary-sources/nnl_edu997013313315805171). The **1922 Mandate** supplies a later and different distribution of authority. Articles **2, 6 and 7** charge the administration with a Jewish national home, facilitated immigration and a nationality law while including protections for other inhabitants. Article **15** states community educational-language rights; **22** names English, Arabic and Hebrew as official languages. These are provisions of the Mandate, not evidence of fulfilment or equal political power. [Complete Avalon transcription, selected articles](https://avalon.law.yale.edu/20th_century/palmanda.asp). The branch therefore contains an attempted coincidence of ancestral people, territory, national language, sovereign law and citizenship, together with a population whose own place and standing that coincidence changes. **Palestinian Arabic, landholding, displacement and citizenship histories are constitutive counter-histories**, not an appendix to a completed national account. The Mandate text cannot narrate their lived consequences by itself. Ottoman, Mandate and subsequent state arrangements retain distinct laws and actors, and the transition between them requires Palestinian records and testimony as well as the national institutions' accounts. Diaspora rabbinic Judaism supplies another relation already retained by the history: peoplehood can persist through text, ritual, communal law and dispersed institutions without a coincident sovereign territory. Modern territorialisation and vernacularisation therefore change the arrangement of existing relations. E3 receives that reconfiguration without denying the older continuities; E2 receives the affected person's capacity to contest the terms of belonging; E6 receives land, schooling and civic capacity as consequential distributions. ### X — Abrahamic formations: Word, law and people have different geometries The comparative **F. E. Peters** branch opens the relation **revelatory Word↔normative Law↔collective identity↔territorial/political order**. Its chronology is plural. It begins before modern national language programmes and continues within them, through traditions whose institutions have repeatedly changed their relation to territory. No selected Peters passage has been recovered here; the comparison remains the admitted historical programme, with its particular documentary tasks intact. In the **Jewish** branch, Torah and halakhic life sustain communal continuity through changing relations to divine obligation, communal authority and host-state law. Dispersion changes the institutional conditions without erasing peoplehood. The Lunel letter above gives one local textual relation within that wider world; it cannot establish a complete history of rabbinic jurisdiction. The **Christian** branch carries a different expansion across peoples and languages. Logos becomes a theological centre; Latin provides a transregional learned and ritual medium; vernacular scripture later enters the Reformation and national-language histories. These phases distinguish the universality claimed by a teaching from the languages and institutions through which it is transmitted. Translation changes access and the distribution of interpretive authority, but a particular church, court or printer must supply the evidence of that change. The **Islamic** branch joins the privilege of Qur'anic Arabic to a multilingual umma. Sharia and fiqh retain their different offices as legal traditions develop across empires, schools and local orders. Sacred-language authority does not imply that every subject of an empire speaks one language or that a single state owns the community. The relevant historical actor can be a jurist, school or local institution rather than a national administration. E3 receives three distributions of Word, people and place which prevent its fourfold from becoming a universal Word-to-nation sequence. E6 receives administration as a received and exercised office whose purpose is not exhausted by the office-holder. A25's covenant and mediating-office relation can compare these histories only with the source, interpreter, obligation and jurisdiction named separately. The present comparative body invents no common Abrahamic constitutional chronology and no missing scriptural witness. ## #5→0 — An inherited category can enter a new institution and act again ### XI — Post-war recombination: rupture and retained capacities The defeat of Nazi Germany in **1945** is a rupture in political rule. The protected programme follows what nevertheless crosses it: personnel, techniques, scientific and intelligence institutions, administrative forms and racial classifications. It also retains a preceding transnational question, the study of **United States racial law by Nazi jurists**, which needs its own legal and deliberative documents. That conduit is not demonstrated by the later recruitment programmes. A **1946 Paperclip policy document**, approved by Truman on **3 September**, gives recruitment an explicit administrative body. It expands exploitation of German and Austrian specialists through contracts, military custody, family movement, screening and possible later immigration status. Its screening clause excludes more-than-nominal Nazi participation and active support, while treating technical honours differently and permitting further screening in doubtful cases. This is the programme's stated rule, not evidence that every appointment complied. The document makes technical value, political admissibility and the authority to decide between them distinct. [FRUS 1946, vol.V, document448, enclosure 2.a–b](https://history.state.gov/historicaldocuments/frus1946v05/d448). The **Gehlen** conduit has a different institutional history. The National Archives' account of the CIA's **2000 acknowledgement and promised release of records** describes the network's post-war Army Intelligence relation and subsequent CIA responsibility through **1956**. It identifies former Nazi and collaborationist backgrounds within the network. The consulted archival notice establishes that disclosed relationship and its record programme; it is not a full personnel audit. [National Archives, 5 October 2000](https://www.archives.gov/iwg/about/press-releases/cold-war-spymaster-records.html). These cases make the inherited theorem concrete without converting it into one continuous hidden regime. Selective repudiation can coexist with recruitment, changed mission and retained expertise. **Incomplete denazification** remains a person- and institution-specific investigation: appointment files, screening decisions and returned authority matter more than a general claim that a profession continued. Financial, imperial and technical continuities likewise require their own conduits. E2 receives the office that admits a person or technique under a new criterion; E6 receives the capacities transferred and the costs omitted; E3 receives an institution's renewed self-description together with the history it must still answer for. ### XII — Computation: classification returns as an executable condition The contemporary branch makes naming materially operative through a repeatable circuit: **mark→name→policy/allocation→changed world→new evidence→stronger or revised name**. A classification enters a database or model; an institution acts through it; the changed opportunities of those classified become part of what later appears as evidence. The return can expose the original cut or conceal it by treating its effects as independent confirmation. This is the protected history's developed operation, with actual deployments requiring their own execution records. A dated technical formulation appears in **Perdomo and colleagues' 2020 Performative Prediction**. Their abstract explicitly treats predictions that alter their targets and introduces performative stability in relation to outcomes produced by acting on predictions. The consulted proceedings abstract supplies that stated research problem; no convergence proof or field trial is claimed read or verified here. It gives the historical branch a named technical neighbour without proving every social feedback mechanism. [PMLR119, pp.7599–7609, abstract](https://proceedings.mlr.press/v119/perdomo20a.html). In **2023**, the [DPO source house](../../../sources/computer-science-ml/rafailov/rafailov-et-al-2023-dpo/SOURCE.md#rafailov-et-al-2023-dpo-q001) supplies a different exact operation: pairwise preference is expressed relative to an optimal and reference policy. Its second card distinguishes a reference available from supervised fine-tuning from an estimated proxy when that source is unavailable. The policy's mathematical office does not itself establish a political defect. The historical and institutional question concerns who selects the preference data, proxy and use of the result, and which later evidence can reach that selection. E6 follows what execution distributes: resources are committed, a course is authorised, an affected other bears consequence and completed work returns with costs and correction rights. The **Name/Power** applications retain those four consequences within E6's five mature operations. They do not add a sixth operation or identify political power with the numerical score. The local reference can be a real **Bimba** for downstream comparisons while remaining **pratibimba** in a wider source relation. Answerability has to reach the appropriate local source, lens, gauge or permission; describing every reference as merely derivative would conceal where effective correction must occur. [Ostrom's 2009 lecture, selected principles and qualification](../../../sources/political-theory-institutions/ostrom/ostrom-2009-beyond-markets-states-nobel-lecture/SOURCE.md#ostrom-2009-beyond-markets-states-nobel-lecture-q001) provides an institutional comparison: affected users can participate in changing rules, local rule-making receives recognition, and governance can be nested. The following passage warns against rigid transplantation. Those findings neither implement the proposed computational return nor prescribe one architecture. They make it possible to ask what power an affected participant actually has over the rule, rather than counting an interface for submitting feedback as proof of that power. ### The next account inherits a history it can reopen The twelve branches return different objects: a treaty's jurisdiction, the language of a court act, a translator's request, a patron's commission, a printed geometrical book, an excluded scholarly field, a psychic image, a language proposal, a racialising law, a school examination, a territorial administration and a recruited specialist. Their differences are what the historical tree contributes to E3. They keep a named people, place or institution from disappearing into a general illustration of classification. The fruit of one cycle becomes the next cycle's ground. A learned language becomes a child's first language; a rule becomes a default; a category becomes an apparently immediate perception. **Neo-nativity** names the closure in which the achieved arrangement makes its own formation unavailable and presents itself as original essence. Historical return recovers that formation while preserving the real life, competence and belonging that have grown through it. The companion **returns-to** [E3's renewed entrustment](../../../etymologies/trust-place-logos-nomos-natio-credere/WHOLE-FIELD.md#credere-renewed-entrustment) with the source and bearer of an undertaking identifiable; to [E2's recollective settlement](../../../etymologies/arbitration-hybris-regard-anamnesis/WHOLE-FIELD.md#resolution-in-reconciliation) with criterion, jurisdiction and affected evidence retained; and to [E6's returned share](../../../etymologies/apportionment-and-economy/WHOLE-FIELD.md#relational-return) with labour, cost and governing capacity able to alter the next act. Fides is the reliance already enacted through those histories; Credere is the renewed undertaking possible after their account has been examined. Neither historical disclosure nor technical observability performs that undertaking on another person's behalf. The whole twelve-branch body is developed here at its inherited standing. Remaining debts concern particular treaties, enforcement and testimony, transmission edges, selected book passages and actual technical execution. # A24 — Arbitration and the Usurpation of Measure

**Standing:** canonical semantic Argument. The whole Arbitration Etymology generates the relations consumed here; A24 develops their consequential office and return without replacing that field.

## #0

Arbitration makes a finite decision where conditions do not decide themselves. [[A15-Ratio-Rationality-Measure-Reckoning-Harmony-Account|A15]] grounds valid measure; [[A19-Complex-as-Local-Arbitration-Regime|A19]] shows a local psychic criterion; [[A23-Trust-Faith-and-the-Formal-Limit|A23]] grounds the trust under which an account is acted upon. Their common pressure is the decision's standing: a criterion must be real enough to act while remaining answerable to what its action concerns.

The [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/etymologies/arbitration-hybris-regard-anamnesis/WHOLE-FIELD|Arbitration whole field]] derives the full conjugate movement:

| Operative face | Conjugate face | Generated relation | Flowering |
|---|---|---|---|
| Continuity | Indeterminacy | Continuity-in-Indeterminacy | Origin / unmeasurable |
| Criterion | Distinction | Criterion-through-Distinction | Measure / Limit |
| Delineation | Difference | Delineation-through-Difference | Perspective / Frame |
| Arbitration | Crisis | Arbitration-in-Crisis | Decision / Hybris |
| Con-text | Diaphaneity | Con-text-through-Diaphaneity | Regard |
| Resolution | Reconciliation | Resolution-in-Reconciliation | Anamnesis / Recognition / Return |

`6 / 6′ → 6+6′` names conjugate generation. It is not twelve nouns merged together, nor the distinct `6×6` recursion in which each position develops its own interior. A generated relation precedes its semantic flowering: **Arbitration-in-Crisis** calls for decision, and hybris names a characteristic failure of that office.

## #1

A criterion distinguishes; a frame gives the distinction a situated edge. Before arbitration there are already admitted witnesses, relevant questions, exclusions, standards and histories of jurisdiction. The adjudicator does not enter an empty field and originate all these conditions by deciding. The lexical HISTORY remembers the arbiter's witnessing, perceiving, weighing and deciding offices; it does not make the deeper disputed derivation of arbiter a warrant for the formal argument.

The philosophical cut becomes concrete when a score changes access, a judgment binds a party or a category determines the response a person receives. A measure can remain useful and repeatable while local. Its failure is the promotion of that locality into source authority: score becomes person, price becomes value, office becomes people, preference becomes the whole of what is wanted. [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/C29-Mediating-Office-Derivative-Sovereignty|C29 Mediating Office]] defines the derivative authority whose conditions disappear in this promotion.

## #2

[[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/mcgoohan-markstein/mcgoohan-markstein-1967-the-prisoner/SOURCE|The Prisoner’s source house]] sources the political Mytheme and its opening exchange. The unnamed resigning agent is abducted into the Village, numbered Six and subjected to surveillance, interrogation and staged social participation. Number Two is a changing administrator; Number One is the hidden authority whose identity Six demands. The answer to the inquiry about One fixes the inquirer as Six.

The asymmetry is precise. Abstraction gives Number Two continuity across replaceable incumbents, while it fixes Number Six as an administrable identity despite the persistence of the living person. The office receives the freedom of impersonality; the captive receives compulsory legibility. Six's refusal contests the exhaustive classification, not number's capacity to carry real relation.

In the finale, Number One's masks disclose Six's own face, followed by escape and an unresolved London return. The inward turn leaves the coercive institution real. It also prevents liberation from being reduced to occupying the sovereign position oneself. The essay's `2→6` / `4+2` refraction figures the seizure of the generating relation and its return as captive index; it is not McGoohan's notation or proof of QL. Exact release/timecode and extended interview collation remain separate source tasks.

## #3

Usurpation occurs when a question about the criterion is answered by another result inside the criterion. Who assigned this weight, what did the comparison exclude, and whose authority binds the judgment? The governed person receives a score instead of an answer. The evaluator's denominator is absent from the account it demands of others. [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/C27-Protected-Account-Occupied-Zero-Source-Claim|C27 Protected Account]] defines this insulation.

Q27's Work/Play inversion adds the accounting mechanism. Public work can become the visible performance while consequential decisions happen in a private field of play. Differentiating those spaces is not itself the failure. Capture occurs when their governing relation is kept off the books: the product circulates as evidence of the office's capacity while its conditions, costs and choices cannot return upon it. This is an authorial process diagnosis; specific political, clinical and institutional allegations in the developmental carrier require independent evidence.

The whole Job comparison developed in [[A20-Image-Valuation-Possession|A20]] supplies the witness-side of the same mechanism: a contradictory life is redescribed to protect an authoritative account. The QL office-confusion survives without making one biblical, psychic, legal and technical history out of these distinct relations.

## #4

**Con-text-through-Diaphaneity** permits regard: the judgment is looked at together with the persons, histories, exclusions and consequences through which it acts. A record of the evaluator's name is only a start. The affected person or excluded field must be able to challenge what the measure counts and how its criterion operates. The response can retain, revise, narrow or withdraw the earlier judgment.

[[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/SOURCE|Agentworld]] compares intelligence embedded in roles, procedures and institutions. The essay's answerability requirement extends that field; appointing a human at its summit does not by itself expose the human's criterion. Verification must have contestable terms and plural sources of resistance. [[A31-Deferential-Intelligence|A31]] tests the evaluator's capacity for revision, and [[A33-Epistemic-Cultivation-Operational-Parity|A33]] tests whether that revision reaches actual operation. Neither test is discharged by a transparent-looking description.

## #5→0

[Māyā — eye, veil, frame and horizon](../../mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/maya-eye-veil-frame-horizon/WHOLE.md#maya-recognition-return): The complete Māyā return **figures** the difference between necessary measure and its usurpation through the six generated relations. Continuity-in-Indeterminacy preserves origin/unmeasurable; Criterion-through-Distinction gives measure; Delineation-through-Difference gives frame; Arbitration-in-Crisis makes decision consequential and exposes hybris; Con-text-through-Diaphaneity enables Regard; Resolution-in-Reconciliation enables Anamnesis. The returned question is which criterion changed and which excluded relation could answer. Constitutive veiling remains positive manifestation rather than already being the secondary seizure of authority.

Taylor’s [black sun and radiating star](../../mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/taylor-authored-images/WHOLE.md#black-sun-radiating-star) **figures** measure protecting its authority by first excluding interiority and then counting the resulting absence as evidence. The authored rings of philanthropy, capital, fixing and their compromising corona distribute dependence and the cost of exit. Cynicism consumes the capacity to answer, and blankness becomes available for reinscription under the same criterion. The star’s return releases capacity to question that measure; it does not demand transfer of allegiance to another centre. These are admitted authorial image operations, with no empirical allegation supplied by their personifications.

[E3’s credere renewed entrustment](../etymologies/trust-place-logos-nomos-natio-credere/WHOLE-FIELD.md#credere-renewed-entrustment) returns the arbitration argument to the reliance that precedes its measure. Fides makes commissioning possible; Nomos institutes a deciding office; Credere receives its consequences in renewed or withheld entrustment. This passage preserves the full conjugate relation and the Prisoner’s Two/Six operation while refusing to let an office’s measure decide in advance whether its own commission may be questioned.

[The Prisoner’s complete political count](submission-package/essay/symbolon/mytheme/worlds/british-television/the-prisoner/WHOLE.md#prisoner-asymmetric-count) **figures** arbitration’s office-confusion through Two’s power to designate Six while withholding the authority of One. A change of office-holder preserves the apparatus unless the governed person can question its criterion. [Job’s disputed court](submission-package/essay/symbolon/mytheme/worlds/biblical/job/WHOLE.md#job-measure-trust-return) **figures** the witness-side of this return: particulars force a hearing, the whirlwind changes judgement’s context, and intercession changes the relation among those who judged.

**Resolution-in-Reconciliation** permits anamnesis: the achieved determination remembers the path by which it acquired force. A valid settlement is not erased because its conditions become visible. Its competence can return to the wider field without sovereignty. [[A21-Individuation-Recognition|A21]] develops that psychic return; [[A25-Covenant-Mediating-Office-Source-Authority|A25]] makes covenant and authority explicit; [[A29-Power-Delegated-Labour-Return|A29]] returns the labour and consequence that the governing account had excluded.

This is a complete cycle of authority rather than endless postponement of decision. The account can act because its office has standing, and its standing remains finite because the people and conditions it concerns can answer. New evidence enters the next determination with the earlier history still consequential. The Etymology receives a sharper source question in return: which actual witness, law, rule and institution made this arbitration possible?

**Depth Restoration:** full 6/6′→6+6′ conjugate relation, measure/frame/decision distinctions, Prisoner office/person asymmetry and inward return, hidden denominator, Work/Play off-book relation, regard and recollective resituation restored from A24's packet, whole Arbitration field, direct historical Argument21 and Q27. **Remaining debt:** lexical publication-grade verification, exact audiovisual locators and concrete legal/political/technical cases. The ratified generated relations are not deferred with those evidence tasks. P1 consumers M03/M40/M46 retain their Movement homes.

The deciding office **returns-to** [Apportionment / Economy whole — Measure is an apportioned criterion](../etymologies/apportionment-and-economy/WHOLE-FIELD.md#measure-is-an-apportioned-criterion) at evidence register 3. The criterion receives a finite office within a distribution of standing and consequence. A challenge must be able to reach that allotment of authority as well as the correctness of its particular decision.

# A25 — Covenant / Mediating Office / Source Authority

## #0

A derivative office can exercise real authority without becoming the source of the field it serves. The relation begins before the office: someone has standing, something has been entrusted, obligations have been acknowledged, and an order has become available for interpretation and action. **Primary arbitration precedes its mediators.** The mediator receives an arbitrated field; receiving it does not make the mediator the source of arbitration.

[A24 — Arbitration](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/arguments/A24-Arbitration-and-the-Usurpation-of-Measure.md) **grounds** the pressure: an apportioned criterion can install itself as the ground of judgment. A25 develops the positive relation through which authority remains executable and answerable. [A23 — Trust](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/arguments/A23-Trust-Faith-and-the-Formal-Limit.md) **grounds** its inherited commitment. The office needs confidence enough to act, and the people relying upon it need a determinate place at which a decision can be made. Their trust does not transfer ownership of the relation to that place.

## #1

Covenant gives this priority a binding form. It joins standing to obligation: the party who receives authority receives something to answer for. The source, the entrusted office and those affected by its decisions belong to one relation, while retaining different offices within it. [C28 — Covenant / Primary Arbitration](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/C28-Covenant-Primary-Arbitration.md) **defines** this first granting of standing; [C29 — Mediating Office / Derivative Sovereignty](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/C29-Mediating-Office-Derivative-Sovereignty.md) **defines** the authority exercised from within what has been granted.

A contract can specify an exchange between parties whose standing it presupposes. Covenant, in this argument's use, reaches that presupposition: what relation gives the parties standing to promise, decide and bind themselves? Its obligations concern the continuance of that relation as well as the product exchanged. [A01 — Faithful Definition](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/arguments/A01-Subject-God-and-Faithful-Definition.md) **compares** the corresponding operation in definition: a finite form gives an account of its source without taking the source's place.

The [Fides / Topos / Logos / Nomos / Natio / Credere whole field](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/etymologies/trust-place-logos-nomos-natio-credere/WHOLE-FIELD.md) **grounds** the distinctions among entrusting, position, account, rule and inherited belonging. Their relation here is an operational construction at evidence register 3. It does not require those words to descend from one root, or the different covenant traditions to instantiate one theology.

## #2

The [[working/final-argument-quilt-2026-08-23/COVENANT-ARBITRATION-AND-MEDIATING-OFFICES-SEAM|authorial covenant seam]] **sources** the sequence through priest, king and politician. Interpretation, memory, rite and transmission give a mediating office work to do. Judgment, distribution and protection give that work executable force. A king can person the unity of an order already received; a political office can receive standing through a constitution, electorate and institutional inheritance. What matters in this argument is the passage from prior standing into situated execution. These are differentiated offices through which to examine the operation, not a universal historical succession asserted for every society.

Repeated execution can conceal the passage. People encounter the office whenever a decision is needed; the authority to decide then looks like the power which originally gave the field its standing. The earlier image of the minister declaring himself king is sharpened by this recovery: **even the king receives an office**. Royal imagery alone cannot tell whether a source-relation has been usurped. The test concerns what the office does with its derivation.

[C27 — Protected Account](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/C27-Protected-Account-Occupied-Zero-Source-Claim.md) **tests** the moment at which an interpretation becomes immune to correction because it is treated as indistinguishable from its source. Legitimate mediation retains its power to interpret and act. The failure begins when the people and relation from which that power comes can no longer address it except in terms it has already authorised.

## #3

The [Apportionment / Economy whole field](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/etymologies/apportionment-and-economy/WHOLE-FIELD.md) **extends** this relation into the distribution of labour. An office acquires effective power through work done elsewhere: people carry out decisions, sustain infrastructure and encounter consequences that the deciding position does not experience directly. If only the completed product returns, the office can appear self-sufficient while its dependence grows. [C53 — Power / Delegated Labour](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/C53-Power-Delegated-Labour.md) **defines** that dependency; [A29](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/arguments/A29-Power-Delegated-Labour-Return.md) **extends** the obligation it places on the commissioning position.

The August 18 ratification makes the required return exact. Resistance, error, cost, dissent and unforeseen possibility must be able to alter the governing model, measure, instruction or purpose. An office which receives evidence only to grade the worker has closed this route at the decisive point. It must also be possible for the evidence to correct the commission.

This is the institutional consequence of the trust-development record's bifurcation. Knowledge can give trust provisional anchors, or project the uncertainty it will not hold onto an excluded object. The [revision-notes source house](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-revision-notes-trust/SOURCE.md) **sources** that authorial development. A returnable office supplies an anchor without requiring its subjects to make the office infallible. [C48 — Trust / Faith under Formal Limit](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/C48-Trust-Faith-under-Formal-Limit.md) **qualifies** its reliance: a binding commitment is finite without becoming disposable whenever it meets difficulty.

## #4

Bratton's [institutional account](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/SOURCE.md#bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q026) **compares** an intelligence carried by rules, roles, precedents and feedback with the intelligence of particular occupants. An office can be occupied by different configurations while its institutional work persists. The [cultural-interoperability passage](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/SOURCE.md#bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q027) **qualifies** that persistence: institutions enter plural cultures and help change the cultures they inherit. These are **Paraphrased** venue propositions, carrying the brief's scenario standing. They do not establish that a particular institution is legitimate.

Ostrom's [participation and nested-governance principles](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/political-theory-institutions/ostrom/ostrom-2009-beyond-markets-states-nobel-lecture/SOURCE.md#ostrom-2009-beyond-markets-states-nobel-lecture-q001) **tests** the return relation against a distinct governance account: those affected participate in making and modifying rules, local rule-making has recognised standing, and governance can operate through nested levels. Her [warning against rigid transplantation](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/political-theory-institutions/ostrom/ostrom-2009-beyond-markets-states-nobel-lecture/SOURCE.md#ostrom-2009-beyond-markets-states-nobel-lecture-q002) **qualifies** any attempt to turn this into a universal institutional recipe. The essay's covenant relation is **Argued from** this comparison; the lecture does not validate a QL commons.

In delegated software agency the corresponding obligation is inspectable: the goal, permission and evaluation criterion must remain distinguishable from the intention they serve. An evaluator can judge a result without becoming the final author of that intention. A contested result must be able to return through the task interpretation to the criterion and, where necessary, the commission itself. [A28 — Authored Ground](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/arguments/A28-Authored-Ground-Positional-Delegation.md) **extends** this positional relation; [A31 — Deferential Intelligence](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/arguments/A31-Deferential-Intelligence.md) **extends** the possibility that fidelity requires objection, alternative or refusal. These are architectural requirements, not a claim that an implementation has already met them.

## #5→0

Taylor’s [God–city–bomb–surveillance–AI sequence](../../mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/taylor-authored-images/WHOLE.md#god-city-bomb-surveillance-ai) **figures** distinct ways a mediating apparatus can appropriate the source-office. Destruction removes a city’s shared conditions; surveillance can retain its buildings while capturing the persons who inhabit them; a fabricated image can present itself as originating witness. An entrusted office answers to these differences when the people and conditions it mediates can change its commission. The sequence’s historical telling and Giegerich relation remain separate source tasks, while the authored distinction between destruction, capture and counterfeit provenance is retained.

The mediating office **returns-to** [Arbitration-in-Crisis → Decision / Hybris](../etymologies/arbitration-hybris-regard-anamnesis/WHOLE-FIELD.md#arbitration-in-crisis) through its received power to settle a consequential dispute. Primary standing, an authorised interpretation and an executed decision remain different offices. Returned labour and affected consequence must be able to revise the commission, so the mediator’s necessary judgment does not appropriate the authority from which it was entrusted to act.

The [Mother, Assumption and chiasm whole](../../mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/mother-assumption-chiasm/WHOLE.md#mother-bearing-return) **figures** a consequential mediating office through bearing and being received. Matrix, mediator and recogniser perform real work, and completion owes them recognition without assigning one image ownership of the field. This is Taylor’s office comparison; doctrinal titles require their separate attribution.

The [Symbol / Account / Trust whole-field — Trust keeps the return route active](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/etymologies/symbol-account-and-trust/WHOLE-FIELD.md#trust-keeps-the-return-route-active) **qualifies** this operation at evidence register 3. An entrusted office makes authority executable while affected consequence can revise its commission. Reliance needs a bearer able to answer beyond the account’s present evidence. The resulting distinction **returns-to** that whole field with the consumer’s own source and evidential limits retained.

The mediating office **returns-to** [the whole Ares–Aphrodite relation](submission-package/essay/symbolon/mytheme/worlds/hellenic/ares-aphrodite-hephaestus-poseidon/WHOLE.md#ares-guarantee-release): Poseidon answers for a possible loss, and Hephaestus acts upon that undertaking. The bride-gifts claimed from Zeus, the spectators’ adulterer’s fine and Poseidon’s contingent payment keep their different speakers and offices. This mythemic relation gives mediation a specific bearer without collapsing the three claims into one historical legal instrument.

Authority returns with its consequence. The source-relation has acquired a determinate act; those affected can answer to it; the office can receive their answer as something capable of revising its terms. Covenant is renewed through this passage. Its fidelity consists in allowing the exercised authority to encounter the conditions it was entrusted to serve.

[A30 — Objective Co-Internality](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/arguments/A30-Objective-Co-Internality.md) **extends** this into relations among distinct worlds without making one world's account sovereign over the others. [A35 — Compassion / Epi-Logos as Vocation](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/arguments/A35-Compassion-Sensitivity-to-Origins-Epi-Logos-as-Vocation.md) **extends** the return upon an achieved institutional account. The [4:2 Technē source house](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/42-techne/42-techne-2026-sovereign-commons/SOURCE.md) **sources** an affiliated design proposal for that application; its implementation, evaluation and public bibliographic debts remain separate from this argued relation.

The page **returns-to** [A24](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/arguments/A24-Arbitration-and-the-Usurpation-of-Measure.md) with the positive criterion its diagnosis requires: authority is derivative, real, and answerable through the labour and lives upon which its exercise depends.

[the Job whole](../../mytheme/worlds/biblical/job/WHOLE.md#job-measure-trust-return) **figures** received mediation in the ending's particular arrangement: the friends whose account has been rebuked must receive Job's prayer. His intercession has real consequence without making him the source of its authority. The office changes their relation through a bearer they had misjudged. This returns covenantal mediation to the difference between serving an originating relation and appropriating its authority; it does not turn Job into a general historical account of covenant.

[the Prisoner whole](../../mytheme/worlds/british-television/the-prisoner/WHOLE.md#prisoner-administered-world) **figures** an office whose successive occupants inherit authority without exposing its source to the governed. Number Two can change while the demand to know why Six resigned and the machinery of his confinement persist. Even Six's election leaves the governing relation intact. The negative case makes received mediation exact: holding an office must include answerability for its terms, rather than treating delegated power as a self-authorising title.

**Depth Restoration:** primary arbitration → entrusted office → executable judgment → affected consequence → revision of the office is restored from the authorial covenant seam, the trust-development record and the August 18 ratification. P1 consumers are M40 and M46; no Movement prose is changed. The reusable distinctions remain C28/C29's office.

The priest/king/politician relation is the recovered authorial operation, not a proved single genealogy. # A28 — Authored Ground / Positional Delegation

## #0

No delegated agent begins from nowhere. A position is authored before it is occupied: an intention has acquired a task, a vocabulary, permissions and criteria under which someone else can act. The author does not thereby determine every consequence. Authored ground gives the delegate a place from which to judge; positional delegation makes that judgment effective within a bounded scope.

[A25 — Covenant / Mediating Office](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/arguments/A25-Covenant-Mediating-Office-Source-Authority.md) **grounds** the prior distinction: office receives authority without becoming its source. [A26 — Objective Internality](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/arguments/A26-Objective-Internality-Mind-as-Worldhood.md) **grounds** the constitutive consequence: the delegated conditions participate in the agent's worldhood.
